get.description: Translates text from one language to another in Lara Translate.

parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.description: Array of text blocks to translate. Each item should include text and a translatable boolean.

schema.description: Array of text blocks to translate. Each item should include text and a translatable boolean.

parameters.name: target
